assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent enemy animation sprite atlas for the painted action RPG Gouden Horizon.
Reference image: the supplied atlas defines the four existing enemy identities and painterly material style. Create NEW coherent animation frames of those exact four enemies, not an enlarged copy of the layout.
Primary request: ONE landscape 6-column by 4-row regular-grid sprite sheet, 24 separate cutout full-body sprites, ideally 3072 by 2048. Six equal columns; four equal rows. Every subject faces diagonally toward the lower right, fixed elevated 2.5D camera and consistent lighting. Same exact character proportions, scale, costume and materials across its row. Keep a full empty transparent gap around every cell, at least 10 percent padding; no overlap across cells.
ROW 1: the reference electric teal marsh predator Boogjager, lean reptilian runner with cyan dorsal fins and long tail, four limbs.
ROW 2: reference Asgraver, squat ochre plated salamander with orange glowing cracks, broad digging claws, weighty quadruped.
ROW 3: reference Schildrover, full-body human scavenger in worn teal riot armor with huge battered brass-and-steel shield in left hand and cyan electric baton in right hand, ochre scarf.
ROW 4: reference Stormnest, stationary rust-and-teal turbine housing with purple storm sac, cyan electrical pods and grounded organic tendrils. No walking legs; its first four frames show a gentle contracting/expanding living pulse with small tendril movement.
Columns 1 through 4: a four-frame looping WALK cycle for rows 1-3: left-side contact, passing pose, right-side contact, opposite passing pose. Genuine changing limb positions, weight transfer, arm counter-swing on humanoid, coherent quadruped anatomy and restrained tail follow-through. No floating or hopping. Column 5: pronounced WINDUP, braced anticipation, head or weapon drawn back, Stormnest sac contracts and gathers electric light. Column 6: ATTACK RELEASE, body leans into the attack, predator lunges head forward, salamander forceful digging swipe, scavenger thrusts baton beyond shield, Stormnest sac releases a contained crackling glow. Maintain apparent scale and foot ground anchors. No huge painted projectiles outside sprite cells.
Premium hand-painted fantasy adventure game rendering, dimensional textured brass, leather, scales and steel, polished silhouettes, refined edge highlights, same teal/ochre/cyan palette as reference. Real alpha background in ALL non-character pixels. No text, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks, grids, separators, cell borders, shadows, grounding circles, scenery, backing colors, checkerboard, colored bars or marks. Consistent anatomy and subject identity across all six frames.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production transparent 6 columns by 2 rows sprite atlas for TWO new poisonous enemies in a modern post-climate-apocalypse premium painted 2.5D adventure game. Same fixed elevated camera and lighting, all figures face diagonally to lower right. Top row: Spuitkever, a squat industrial marsh beetle with six jointed insect legs, salvaged teal-and-brass tank shell, green bioluminescent poison abdomen and forward siphon mandibles. Bottom row: Gifmeester, a human scavenger in worn teal hazmat suit, ochre respirator, backpack of green toxic glass bottles, heavy brown boots, brass chemical sprayer with green glowing nozzle in both hands. Six equal columns in each row: first four are a coherent LOOPING WALK cycle with opposite feet alternating and full-body weight shift; fifth is braced anticipation / poison charged; sixth is attack release, beetle squirts from siphon and human thrusts sprayer forward with a small contained green mist. Every column shows same exact subject identity and scale. Strong material detail and dimensional hand-painted game finish, distinct silhouettes and readable green poison accents, no pixel art. Full body, all legs/weapons/antennas inside each cell with 12% clear transparent safety gap; no overlap. Landscape canvas ideally 3072x1024. Genuinely transparent alpha everywhere except sprites, no ground, scenery, cast shadows, circles, grid, labels, text, names, numbers, logo, checkerboard or colored backing.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production painted 2.5D isometric action RPG optional arena background, wide landscape 3:2 canvas. A derelict tidal salvage yard in post-climate-apocalypse Netherlands: an enormous OPEN WALKABLE STONE COURTYARD occupies 70% of the image centre, surrounded at the perimeter by flooded canals, rusted teal pump equipment, brass salvage cranes, derelict boats, reeds and stacked salvage crates. Elevated adventure-game camera matching a painterly Torchlight-like dimensional style, rich tactile hand-painted surfaces, crisp warm golden daylight, teal water, ochre masonry. Main arena ground extends from 20% to 85% horizontal and 20% to 78% vertical; no walls, equipment, rubble, plants, water or deep cracks inside this broad central polygon. Keep the centre clear for fast combat. Arrival at southwest of court, exit platform at northeast, ornamental branching salvage alleys along outside perimeter. No characters, enemies, readable text, UI, portals, weapons or loot props in the central court. Premium cohesive environment art, beautiful composition. The world is flooded but combat floor is dry and perfectly continuous.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production painted 2.5D isometric action RPG optional arena background, wide landscape 3:2 canvas. Abandoned solar rail depot in the post-climate-apocalypse Netherlands: huge OPEN DRY STONE COURTYARD occupies 70% of centre, weathered railway platform and teal/brass maintenance structures only around outside perimeter, overgrown suspended rails, solar panels, copper pipes, luminous green glass tanks at outer edges. Elevated dimensional adventure-game camera, premium hand-painted environment art, warm late afternoon orange daylight with teal reflected shadows, rich wood steel brass and masonry detail. Broad uncluttered combat floor runs from 20% to 85% horizontal and 20% to 78% vertical. No floor-blocking equipment, track barriers, rubble, raised platforms, vegetation, water or holes in centre. Dry southwest arrival and northeast exit points connected through the open court. No people, enemies, loot, text, UI or portals. Safe framing, clear playable floor, atmospheric high-quality painted postindustrial ecology.

integration: 36 connected silhouettes were extracted and repacked; torso-centred ground anchors and shared scales align the enemy frames. Hero walking uses the existing painted directional bind poses with opposed two-bone foot contacts, weight shift and torso counter-swing.
